results.title: Copper set to test $15 000 as investors await US data, tariff clarity
results.description: Copper prices could break through $15 000 for the first time as soon as this week, analysts said on Tuesday, as investors position for another round of US economic data and President Donald Trump keeps the market guessing on import tariffs. Benchmark copper on the London Metal Exchange hit an all-time peak of $14 779 per metric ton, climbing for a fourth straight session as the rally showed no sign of slowing.

results.title: Samsung is shutting down two apps it once bragged about
results.description: Samsung is shutting down AR Doodle and Quick Measure on Dec. 31 as it pivots from AR to AI across Galaxy devices and future One UI versions.
